pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped tan polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch spatial area is greatest on the mid-flank, with a marked reduction in size and increased density toward the shoulder and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored pathways forming a topological graph with primarily 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank and tapers slightly at the transition to the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude jagged silhouette visible along the mane from the upper neck to the shoulder. The frequency of the serration is consistent, though edge definition is softened by depth-of-field blur.
